text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All eyes are on Grass Wonder and Special Week as the Arima Kinen finally gets underway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder expresses her appreciation and respect for all the Umamusume running, but declares that she won't allow any of them to take her lead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She then walks to the arena for today's monumental race.
